_comment: Example parameter file for a MANUAL `az deployment group create --parameters @infra/main.parameters.json`. The deploy workflow (.github/workflows/deploy.yml) passes parameters inline, so CI does not read this file. Deploy order: infra/registry.bicep, then infra/postgres.bicep (plus its one-time SQL bootstrap), then this template. maxReplicas stays 1: internal/api/events.go is an in-process SSE hub, so a second replica silently breaks chat streaming — see the header of infra/main.bicep. provisionRedis stays false for the same reason, and because the app refuses to boot when PAD_REDIS_URL is set but unreachable.

encryptionKey.value: <openssl rand -hex 32, DIFFERENT from authSecret; set it before users store provider keys — changing it later makes them unreadable>

metricsToken.value: <openssl rand -hex 32; without it GET /metrics is public, because PAD_BEHIND_PROXY makes the private-IP allowlist vacuous>

parameters._email_comment: Without SMTP the app falls back to a log-only mailer: password-reset and email-verification links are written to Log Analytics instead of being delivered.
parameters._sso_comment: All three of issuer/clientId/redirectUrl are required together, or SSO stays off. Entra ID issuer: https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant-id}/v2.0
parameters._ai_knobs_comment: Azure Foundry / knowledge-base operator knobs (see .env.example); the CI deploy (.github/workflows/deploy.yml) passes them from repository variables, not secrets — none is sensitive. aiAllowPrivateEgress needs VNet integration, which this template does not provision.
